topic: How can frequency planning address interference between satellite uplinks and broadband power line communication systems?
consensus_response: Frequency planning addresses interference by allocating distinct sub-bands, utilizing time-division multiplexing, advanced filtering, dynamic exclusion zones, and adaptive power control. Integrating machine learning and cognitive radio technologies enhances predictive interference mitigation and autonomous decision-making, optimizing system performance and reliability.
reference_context: Satellite communication systems operate on various frequency bands, including S, L, Ku, and Ka, with specific uplink and downlink frequencies, requiring careful planning to minimize interference.
